| `getMinimumLevel()` | Gets the minimum level required for the world, 0 if no minimum level. |
| `getRealId()` | Gets the real ID of the world, less than 300 |

| `getWorld()` | Gets the ID of the world, greater than 300 |
| `isDeadmanMode()` | -- GETTER -- Checks if the world is deadman mode |
| `isF2P()` | Checks if the world is a F2P world |
| `isFreshStart()` | -- GETTER -- Checks if the world is a Fresh Start world |
| `isHighRisk()` | -- GETTER -- Checks if the world is High Risk |
| `isMembers()` | Checks if the world is a Members only world |
| `isNormal()` | Normal checks to not be: Deadman Mode, Tournament World, League World, PVP, High Risk, Speed Running, Target World, PVP Arena, Suspicious (New/Unknown/Testing types), Beta, Fresh Start |
| `isPVP()` | Checks if the world is PVP |
| `toString()` | Gets the String value of the world, example: W330 |

| Method | Description |

| `changeWorldHopperDirect(World w)` | Directly calls an interaction on the in game world hopper menu to hop worlds. |
| `dcHop(int world)` | If you're logged in, it will force a disconnect before forcing a world change. |
| `hopWorld(int world)` | Hops to specified world |
| `hopWorld(int world, boolean combatCheck)` | Uses the in game hopper to change worlds Note: This does choose the option to not ask again. |
| `hopWorld(World w)` | Hops to specified World |
| `quickHop(int world)` | Deprecated. see dcHop(int) |

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `all()` | Gets a List of all the worlds |
| `all(Filter <World> filter)` | Returns a List of all worlds that match the given Filter |
| `clearWorlds()` | Clears the world list and sets it to null |
| `f2p()` | Returns a list of f2p Worlds |
| `getCurrent()` | Gets your current world |
| `getExactLocation(World w)` | Uses the world hopper widgets in game to determine real location of a given world. |
| `getNormalizedWorlds()` | Gets a list of normalized Worlds Normalized meaning not: pvp, deadmode, tournament, twisted leauge, last man standing, bounty hunter, or high risk. |

| `getWorld(Filter <World> filter)` | Gets the first World that matches the filter |
| `highRisk()` | Gets a list of high risk worlds |
| `members()` | returns a List of members only worlds |
| `noMinimumLevel()` | Gets a list of worlds with no required level |
| `pvp()` | Gets a list of pvp worlds |
